manifest.notes: Municipal boundaries dissolved by island group. Long northern rings simplified at 0.000016 degrees. Takeshima and Senkaku retain all source vertices. WGS84 coordinates stored with six decimal places in northern groups and eight in Takeshima/Senkaku. The source includes mapped offshore rocks; polygon parts are not a count of named islands or a maritime boundary.
